verdict.summary: Round 3 confirms the timestamp-selection fix remains correct and complete. Every candidate timestamp is parsed before comparison, unusable values are skipped, and aware datetimes are compared by instant, preserving valid stale-export evidence even when malformed or differently offset stamps are present. The focused tests exercise both direct winner selection and the real scanner trigger without relying on the independent missing-reference fallback. No new correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff. Since round 2 also had no findings and the reviewed change is materially unchanged, progress is stagnant.
